event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: LAT 219015 had received the supplied bibs from the OA during registration.
LAT 219015 sailed in races 5 and 6 without their bib.
LAT 219015 was aware of SI 2.5, which stated: "All competitors will receive a bib vest and it is mandatory to wear it".
conclusions: LAT 219015 did not wear the bib provided by the Organising Authority when racing and broke SI 2.5.
Since the breach did not affect racing performance, the penalty should be applied to the race sailed nearest in time to that of the incident.
decision: Using the WS Discretionary Penalty Policy, a starting penalty of 5% was decided. There were no facts to justify decreasing the penalty. There were no facts to justify increasing the penalty. LAT 219015 to be scored with a 5% Scoring penalty applied to race 5.
